verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure. The headline and subline are left-aligned while the phone and CTA are centred, so the axes are mixed. The subline is tiny and separated from the headline by a large gap. The cream circle is a clipped, orphaned blob in the bottom-left corner, and there is dead space at the top. A's 'ONLINE ONLY' badge is shrunk until it can't be read, and it sits stranded under the CTA. B's badge is readable but floats off-axis, lower-left of the CTA, and B's phone is smaller, which leaves more empty space. B wins only narrowly because its badge text survives.
